title: Blue Account: Managing your balance with low-balance alerts
summary: This document explains how to enable Blue Account low-balance alerts and set the threshold to $62, so you’re notified when your available balance reaches or falls below $62. It also gives tips on acting before transactions post and steps to take after an alert triggers (review pending/posted items, then add funds or adjust transactions to get above $62).
faqs: How do I enable low-balance alerts on my Blue Account?
What alert threshold should I set to receive early warnings?
When does a low-balance alert trigger?
After I receive an alert, what should I review to find what lowered my balance?
